abstract: Eighty-four patients with testicular seminoma were treated at the Northern Israel Oncology Center during the years 1968-1988. Using the staging classification of Hussey, 69 patients (82%) had Stage I, eight (10%) had Stage IIA, four (5%) had Stage IIB, one (1%) had Stage IIIA, and two (2%) had Stage IIIB disease. Sixty-nine patients (82%) had classic pure seminoma, nine (11%) had anaplastic seminoma and six (7%) had spermatocytic seminoma. Seventy-four patients (88%) underwent high inguinal orchiectomy and ten (12%) had a scrotal approach. Seventy-five patients (85%) were treated with postoperative irradiation. Stage I patients received 26-30 Gy to the paraaortic and ipsilateral pelvic lymph nodes. Stage IIA patients were treated in the same manner with a boost to the involved lymph nodes. With a mean follow-up of 97 months, 65 patients (77%) are alive and well with no evidence of disease, 7 patients (8%) are dead due to disease progression. The 5-, 10-, 15-, and 20-year actuarial survival for all patients was 90%, and for early stage patients 94%. Eight patients (14%) relapsed; 3 of them were salvaged by chemotherapy. Serious side effects of irradiation included lethal respiratory failure due to bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis in one patient, peptic ulcer in three patients, hydronephrosis due to paraureteral fibrosis in one patient and recurrent paralytic ileus in one patient. Eight patients (10%) developed nine second cancers, three of them within the previous radiation field.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 1968年から1988年の間に、北イスラエル腫瘍センターで精巣セミノーマの患者84例が治療を受けた。Husseyの病期分類を用いると、69例(82%)が病期I、8例(10%)が病期IIA、4例(5%)が病期IIB、1例(1%)が病期IIIA、2例(2%)が病期IIIBであった。69例(82%)が古典的純粋型セミノーマ、9例(11%)が未分化セミノーマ、6例(7%)が精母細胞性セミノーマであった。74例(88%)が高位鼠径部精巣摘除術を受け、10例(12%)が陰嚢アプローチを受けた。75例(85%)が術後照射を受けた。病期Iの患者には、傍大動脈およびの同側骨盤リンパ節に26～30Gyの照射が行われた。病期IIAの患者も同様に治療され、病変リンパ節に追加照射が行われた。平均97か月のフォローアップで、65例(77%)が無病で生存しており、7例(8%)が病勢進行により死亡した。全症例の5年、10年、15年、20年の生命表による生存率は90%であり、早期病期の患者では94%であった。8例(14%)が再発し、そのうち3例は化学療法で救済された。照射による重篤な副作用として、ブレオマイシンによる肺線維症に起因する致死的呼吸不全が1例、消化性潰瘍が3例、傍尿管線維化による水腎症が1例、再発性麻痺性イレウスが1例認められた。8例(10%)が9件の二次がんを発症し、そのうち3件は以前の照射野内に生じた。(抄録は250語で打ち切り)
